message.dmzkicontrol.lost_skill: Seal ended: you no longer have the required skill.

cutscene.dmzkicontrol.title: AURA CONTROL
cutscene.dmzkicontrol.subtitle: Your ki is now held inside your body

race.dragonminez.cerealian.desc: A nearly extinct people from planet Cereal. A Cerealian's right eye sees ki and enemy weak points, making them the finest snipers in the universe. Hold B to use the Cereal Eye.
message.dmzkicontrol.eye_not_cerealian: Only Cerealians have the Cereal Eye.
message.dmzkicontrol.eye_no_ki: Not enough ki to keep the Cereal Eye open.
skill.dragonminez.racial_cerealian.desc: A Cerealian's right eye sees ki. Hold B to aim: sniper zoom, outlines on everyone with ki nearby and weak points (red circles) on the target. Passives: Trajectory Reading (chance to dodge projectiles) and Precise Gaze (extra crit). Ki blasts become thin, precise shots.
skill.dragonminez.cereal_eye.desc: Cerealian only. Each level reveals one more weak point on the target (up to 4), increases Cereal Eye range, dodge and crit chance, and lowers its ki cost. Level 2 unlocks Ki Bow.
item.dmzkicontrol.cereal_scope.tip2: Cerealians: +1 weak point, +16 blocks of range and half the ki cost for the Cereal Eye
item.dmzkicontrol.cereal_scope.tip3: Wear it on your head or in the Head Tech slot (like the scouter)
message.dmzkicontrol.eye_precise: Precise shot on a weak point!
message.dmzkicontrol.eye_learned: Your Cerealian eye awakened: Aim skill (level 1). Hold B to aim.
message.dmzkicontrol.ki_arrow_learned: You learned Ki Bow! Equip it in the ki techniques menu.
skill.dragonminez.aura_control.desc: Taught by Goku after the Frieza Saga. Seals the aura inside the body (N key) to spend much less ki in a transformation, like Goku's Blue in the Black arc. Each level raises the seal's efficiency, speeds up mastery, lowers strain and unlocks harder forms: Lv2 SSJ2/Kaioken, Lv3 SSJ3/God, Lv4 Blue/SSJ4, Lv5 Ultra Instinct/Ultra Ego.
message.dmzkicontrol.need_aura_level: This form requires Aura Control level %s (you have %s).
message.dmzkicontrol.aura_teacher_locked: Goku: "Easy there! Finish the fight against Frieza first, then I'll teach you to hold your aura in." (TP refunded)
message.dmzkicontrol.goku_level_1: Goku: "Don't let your ki slip out through the aura. Hold it in, right here in your chest." (Aura Control Lv1)
message.dmzkicontrol.goku_level_2: Goku: "That's it! Now try it in Super Saiyan 2. The stronger the form, the more the ki wants to leak." (Aura Control Lv2)
message.dmzkicontrol.goku_level_3: Goku: "You're getting the hang of it! Even in Super Saiyan 3 you save a ton of energy this way." (Aura Control Lv3)
message.dmzkicontrol.goku_level_4: Goku: "Whis made me train this so I wouldn't run out of steam in Blue. Now you can do it too!" (Aura Control Lv4)
message.dmzkicontrol.goku_level_5: Goku: "Perfect control! With all your ki locked inside, you can even stack Kaioken on top without wasting any." (Aura Control Lv5)
message.dmzkicontrol.perfected_blue: Perfected Blue: your ki is born locked inside the body — aura sealed.
message.dmzkicontrol.aura_story_cap: Goku: "You can't go past this yet. Aura Control level %s comes after: %s." (TP for the extra levels refunded)
message.dmzkicontrol.form_removed: That form was removed (non-canon or duplicate); you're back to normal.
item.dmzkicontrol.blindfold.tip1: Fight without sight: you only sense ki
item.dmzkicontrol.blindfold.tip2: Range grows with Ki Sense. In combat: +20% TP (more with Ki Sense)
item.dmzkicontrol.blindfold.tip3: With Ki Sense, Solar Flare won't blind you either: you switch to ki vision
message.dmzkicontrol.bubbles_start: Level %s! Catch Bubbles within %s seconds. No flying, no teleporting, no dashing: legs only!
message.dmzkicontrol.bubbles_start_repla: Another round at level %s? You have %s seconds!
message.dmzkicontrol.bubbles_half: Half the time is gone! Faster!
message.dmzkicontrol.bubbles_win: You caught Bubbles! Level %s cleared. +%s TP
message.dmzkicontrol.bubbles_next_level: He'll be sharper next time. Level %s unlocked!
message.dmzkicontrol.bubbles_master: Amazing! You caught Bubbles on the hardest level. You're ready for Gregory!
message.dmzkicontrol.bubbles_fail_time: Time's up! Bubbles is smarter than he looks.
message.dmzkicontrol.bubbles_busy: Bubbles is already training with someone else. Wait your turn!
message.dmzkicontrol.bubbles_rest: Rest a bit before chasing him again. Come back in %s.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.1.name: The Patrol Comes for Buu
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.1.desc: A Galactic Patrol ship sets down by Kame House. Jaco, the officer in charge, has come to lock Majin Buu away for what he did in a past life, and he stays polite right up until Goku and Vegeta step in his way.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.2.name: Special Members
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.2.desc: Jaco offers a deal: Buu stays free if Goku and Vegeta sign up as Special Members of the Galactic Patrol. Vegeta wants to know whether the badge comes with a salary.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.3.name: Ten Million Years
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.3.desc: The Galactic Prison has been broken open and its oldest inmate is out. Stop the escapees who reached this system before they scatter.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.4.name: What Piccolo Remembers
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.4.desc: Piccolo knows the name Moro from the stories Namekian elders tell: a sorcerer who went from planet to planet, drinking their power until nothing was left. Go and hear him out.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.5.name: The Escaped
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.5.desc: Prisoners who followed Moro out are stealing ships and heading further into the system. Catch them before they find somewhere to hide.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.6.name: New Planet Namek
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.6.desc: The Dragon Balls of Namek are Moro's next meal, and he sent soldiers ahead to prepare the way. Reach New Namek and cut them down.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.7.name: The Planet-Eater
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.7.desc: Moro himself has arrived: an aged, goat-horned sorcerer in a heavy cloak who does not need to fight, because everything he touches is already losing strength. Hold the line.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.8.name: A Magic That Drinks Power
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.8.desc: Every blast you threw only fed him. Goku admits out loud that brute force is the wrong tool this time, and asks who might know another way.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.9.name: Merus Answers a Call
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.9.desc: A quiet Galactic Patrol officer named Merus offers to teach Goku what strength alone cannot: to move without deciding to. He is not quite what he seems.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.10.name: Lessons in Stillness
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.10.desc: Merus's first lesson is to stop thinking. He sets soldiers on you and expects you to avoid their blows before you know they moved.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.11.name: The Body Moves First
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.11.desc: The second lesson is harder. Merus does not want you to react; he wants your body to act while your mind watches.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.12.name: Moro's Second Feast
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.12.desc: Moro has taken the magic of a whole planet and grown stronger for it. That first fight was only a taste.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.13.name: Bandits from the Void
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.13.desc: Saganbo's Galactic Bandit Brigade trails Moro for whatever he leaves behind: ships, ki reserves, whole worlds' worth of scraps. Their leader is the one to break.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.14.name: Gohan Steps Up
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.14.desc: Gohan has not trained for years and still volunteers first. Someone has to face the brigade's strongest fighter, and he wants it to be him.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.15.name: Seven-Three
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.15.desc: The brigade's enforcer, a wall of armour and bad temper, stands between the fighters and the ships. Take him down.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.16.name: Yardrat Calls
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.16.desc: Vegeta goes off alone. When he comes back he will not say where he has been, only that the Yardrat know a way to force stolen power out of someone else, and that he will teach it once he has proved it works.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.17.name: Forced Spirit Fission
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.17.desc: Vegeta's lesson turns on forcing one energy out of another. Prove it on soldiers stuffed full of stolen power.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.18.name: Senzu for the Wounded
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.18.desc: The Patrol's medics have run out of everything. Gather senzu beans and bring them to Piccolo.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.19.name: The Namekian Wish
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.19.desc: The Namekians decide the Dragon Balls are safer used than hidden. Gather them and call Porunga. Whatever you wish for, Moro will still come.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.20.name: The Cloak Comes Off
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.20.desc: Fed on the power of a whole planet, Moro drops the heavy cloak. Under it he is lean, fast and looks younger than he has any right to. Beat him back.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.21.name: The Sign
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.21.desc: Goku's body moves before he does. For the first time the state Merus taught carries a whole fight, and it costs him more than it should.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.22.name: Merus's Last Lesson
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.22.desc: Merus shows Goku how to hold the state instead of flashing into it, then admits that teaching it broke every rule an angel has. He will pay for that later.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.23.name: Rules Broken for a Student
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.23.desc: The angels have noticed what Merus has done, and so have Moro's soldiers, drawn to the disturbance. Hold the ground while he finishes.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.24.name: Vegeta Reborn
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.24.desc: Vegeta has stopped fighting to look strong. Whatever he learned on Yardrat, he wants to show it to Goku before facing Moro.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.25.name: The Planet-Eater Feeds
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.25.desc: Moro has swallowed the magic of an entire world. Bigger, younger and done with restraint, he is finally fighting with everything he took.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.26.name: Nothing Left to Consume
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.26.desc: Goku steps in with the state Merus gave him, and with a technique that turns Moro's hunger against him.
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.27.name: A Galactic Patrolman
quest.dmzkicontrol.moro.27.desc: It is over. Goku is an official Galactic Patrolman now: a badge, a uniform he will not wear, and a long list of prisoners who will one day escape.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.1.name: A Bounty Hunter Among the Stars
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.1.desc: A stranger in a buckled eyepatch and a long gray scarf lands near Goku's house. Granolah calls himself the last Cerealian and says he is hunting Frieza. He is not sure yet whether you are on his side. Once you have spoken to him, the space pod can take you to Cereal Planet.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.2.name: The Last Cerealian
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.2.desc: Goku listens to the whole story: a peaceful planet, a race that vanished overnight, and one survivor who spent decades tracking the man he believes did it.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.3.name: Heeter Scouts
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.3.desc: Granolah was followed. A handful of armoured troopers wearing the red of an outfit nobody has heard of are combing the area for him. Take them down before they report back.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.4.name: Ashes of Cereal
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.4.desc: Granolah takes you to what is left of his homeworld: pale dunes, wrecked towers and silence. The troopers are already there, picking through the ruins.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.5.name: The Wrong Enemy
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.5.desc: Granolah sees Saiyans and cannot see anything else. He believes a Saiyan pulled the trigger on his people, and he will not take your word for it. Convince him the only way he will listen.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.6.name: Vegeta Does Not Apologise
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.6.desc: Vegeta's pride takes a hit: he cannot deny what Saiyans did on other worlds, and he will not say sorry for it. He does agree that the timeline does not add up.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.7.name: Family Business
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.7.desc: A small army arrives in ships marked with the same crest as the troopers. Whoever leads them wants Granolah alive and you gone.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.8.name: The Big One
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.8.desc: Oil is the largest of the Heeter siblings, and he has never missed a meal. He does not care whose planet this is, only that something on it is edible.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.9.name: Macki's Trap
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.9.desc: Macki is the only sister and the information broker of the family. She keeps the fight short and cruel: she wants Granolah tired before her brother arrives.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.10.name: The Smallest One
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.10.desc: The Heeter nobody was afraid of turns out to be the strongest of them. Gas is small, cold and quick, and he fights like he has been waiting for this.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.11.name: Monaito Will Not Leave
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.11.desc: An old Namekian healer has stayed on the ruins for years and rebuilt what he could. He is the one who made the two Cereal Dragon Balls, and he gives you a radar to find them. Monaito has one more thing to tell you, and it will not sit well with Granolah.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.12.name: Provisions for the Ruins
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.12.desc: Monaito can mend Granolah's sight, but he needs supplies. Bring senzu beans and take them to him.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.13.name: The Wish
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.13.desc: Granolah has the Cerealian Dragon Balls and one wish left: to be the strongest warrior in the universe, whatever it costs him. Goku argues against it. Granolah has waited too long to listen.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.14.name: A Survivor's Strength
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.14.desc: His hair falls to his knees and his body is not the one you knew. The wish held. Granolah is stronger than he has ever been, and he is still angry.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.15.name: Elec's Scheme
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.15.desc: Goku and Vegeta start to see who has been working the room. Elec, the eldest Heeter, has been playing both sides, and he has been playing them for a long time.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.16.name: Air Raid
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.16.desc: Heeter ships dive onto the ruins. Hold the line until Granolah and Gas are through with each other.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.17.name: Gas Reaches Higher
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.17.desc: Gas is not done. Every time he is knocked down he gets up faster, and something in his eyes says he is fighting the fight he has always wanted.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.18.name: The Puppeteer
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.18.desc: Elec has watched long enough. He steps in himself, and he is far more dangerous than the brother who does his fighting.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.19.name: Elec's Wish
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.19.desc: The Heeters have their own set of Dragon Balls and Elec has one thing left to ask for: to make his youngest brother the strongest mortal in the universe. It works.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.20.name: The Strongest Mortal
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.20.desc: Gas is taller now, older-looking, with horns at his temples and a red coat that hangs to his knees. He does not hurry.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.21.name: Vegeta's Ego
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.21.desc: Vegeta refuses to be beaten by someone else's wish. Whatever he taps into, it is all his own: pride with nowhere else to go.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.22.name: Instinct
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.22.desc: Goku's body does the work when his mind cannot keep up, and it costs him. It is the only reason he is still standing.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.23.name: What Monaito Saw
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.23.desc: Monaito finally tells the truth he has carried for decades: he was there the day Cereal fell, and he knows who really did it. It was not what Granolah was told.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.24.name: The Scouter Recording
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.24.desc: Monaito hands you a Saiyan scouter he pulled from the ruins years ago. It still holds the last message of the man who first came to Cereal. Bring it to Vegeta.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.25.name: The Berserker
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.25.desc: Gas tears through his own limits. His eyes change, his body swells and the coat burns off him. He is not thinking any more.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.26.name: Everything Together
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.26.desc: Granolah, Goku and Vegeta stop fighting each other and put everything they have into one attack. It might be enough.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.27.name: An Emperor Returns
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.27.desc: Frieza arrives on the ruins in a new form, black and gold, and he has come to remind everyone whose empire it is. Whatever the Heeters planned, it ends here.
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.28.name: What Is Left of Cereal
quest.dmzkicontrol.granolah.28.desc: It is over. The Heeters are gone and Frieza has left. Granolah looks at the sky, and for the first time in a long while he does not look like a man on a hunt.
dmz.saga.dmzkicontrol_moro: Dragon Ball Super: Galactic Patrol Prisoner
dmz.saga.dmzkicontrol_granolah: Dragon Ball Super: Granolah the Survivor
item.dragonminez.cereal_dball_radar.tool: Finds the two Dragon Balls on Cereal Planet.
wish.toronbo.strongest.name: Become the strongest warrior in the universe
wish.toronbo.strongest.desc: Only a Cerealian can bear it: unlocks Power of the Wish in exchange for years of life (max health drops for good).
wish.toronbo.senzu.name: Senzu Beans
wish.toronbo.tps.name: Awaken potential
message.dmzkicontrol.toronbo.granted: Toronbo: "Your wish has been granted." You unlocked Power of the Wish.
message.dmzkicontrol.toronbo.cost: The price: years of your life. Your max health dropped %s%% for good.
message.dmzkicontrol.toronbo.not_cereali: Toronbo: "I can only give you the power that already lies within you." (+%s TP)
message.dmzkicontrol.toronbo.already: Toronbo: "You already received that power." (+%s TP)
scene.dmzkicontrol.saiyan.falseform.fals: Rage sparks something the body does not yet understand.
scene.dmzkicontrol.saiyan.ssgrades.super: Pure fury awakens the legend asleep in the blood.
Muscles swell: more strength, less control.
Enormous power trapped in a body too slow for it.
scene.dmzkicontrol.saiyan.supersaiyan.su: Calm as the base form. Strong as the legend.
Lightning cuts through the aura. The limit breaks again.
The planet shakes as the hair falls down the back.
The full moon wakes the giant ape inside the Saiyan.
scene.dmzkicontrol.saiyan.oozaru.goldeno: The fur turns gold: the beast and the legend become one.
scene.dmzkicontrol.saiyan.oozaru.supersa: The beast returns to a man's size, its power intact.
scene.dmzkicontrol.saiyan.legendaryforms: The eyes go white. Rage takes command.
Green and gold: the power that destroyed its own planet.
Nothing holds it back anymore. Not the body, not reason.
scene.dmzkicontrol.saiyan.godritual.supe: Six righteous hearts, hand in hand, kindle the divine flame.
scene.dmzkicontrol.saiyan.godforms.super: A serene power, red like an ember that never dies out.
Divine ki inside a Super Saiyan's body. Perfect control.
Not a spark escapes: every bit of ki kept inside the body.
scene.dmzkicontrol.saiyan.evildivineform: Divine ki stained pink, beautiful and cruel.
scene.dmzkicontrol.saiyan.beastforms.bea: Forgotten rage returns at once. The hair turns white.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.kaioken.x2.title: KAIOKEN x2
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.kaioken.x2.sub: Taught by King Kai: double everything, for a price.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.kaioken.x3.title: KAIOKEN x3
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.kaioken.x3.sub: Three times the power. The muscles start to complain.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.kaioken.x4.title: KAIOKEN x4
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.kaioken.x4.sub: Four times. Every second takes its toll on the body.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.kaioken.x10.title: KAIOKEN x10
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.kaioken.x10.sub: Ten times the power. The body is at its limit.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.kaioken.x20.title: KAIOKEN x20
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.kaioken.x20.sub: Twenty times. One step past what any body can bear.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.kaioken.x100.sub: One hundred times. Madness only a Saiyan would try.
The gods' ki flows through the veins, silent.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.ultimate.ultimate: Dormant potential, fully released without strain.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.ultrainstinct.sig: The body moves on its own. The mind only watches.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.ultrainstinct.mas: Silver hair. Not one thought gets in the way of movement.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.ultraego.sign.sub: The more it is hit, the stronger it grows. A destroyer's pride.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.ultraego.mastered: A God of Destruction's ki: every blow taken becomes power.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.frostgodforms.gol: Real training, for the first time. The result shines.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.frostgodforms.bla: Ten years in the Time Chamber. A silence that terrifies.
scene.dmzkicontrol.human.superforms.buff: Years of pure training, now in every muscle.
scene.dmzkicontrol.human.superforms.full: Holding nothing back: every drop of ki out.
scene.dmzkicontrol.human.superforms.over: A human pushing past their own limit, lightning on the skin.
scene.dmzkicontrol.human.superforms.sola: The ki shines like a small sun rising.
Forbidden technique: the body burns red.
Deeper into the forbidden technique. The body grows to bear it.
Four arms. The final price of the forbidden technique.
scene.dmzkicontrol.human.majinandroidfor: Babidi's mark glows on a machine's forehead.
scene.dmzkicontrol.human.majuubstyle.awa: Majin Buu's power reborn in a human heart.
scene.dmzkicontrol.human.androidforms.an: Infinite energy: the inner reactor starts without a sound.
scene.dmzkicontrol.human.androidforms.su: Energy plates lock into place. Stronger, still cold.
scene.dmzkicontrol.human.androidforms.fu: Two machines become one. All of hell trembles.
scene.dmzkicontrol.any.androidforms.gamm: A Red Ribbon hero, ready for the first mission.
The safety limiters shut off one by one.
Beyond the design. The metal glows orange.
scene.dmzkicontrol.namekian.superforms.g: The body grows up to the clouds.
An ancient Namekian technique: grow as big as a mountain.
scene.dmzkicontrol.namekian.superforms.f: The fusion with other Namekians reveals everything.
scene.dmzkicontrol.namekian.superforms.s: Namek's legendary warrior, green lightning in the aura.
scene.dmzkicontrol.namekian.legendaryfor: The evil half that was cast out speaks louder again.
The Demon King of Evil, as big as a castle.
Malice fills the body with muscle.
The Grand Elder touches the head and all hidden power wakes.
A wish to Shenron kindles an orange giant.
The Orange Namekian grows until it touches the sky.
scene.dmzkicontrol.frostdemon.evolutionf: The horns grow, the body doubles in size.
The head stretches out. A frightening look.
The shell breaks. Small, smooth, and far more dangerous.
The muscles swell: one hundred percent of the power, no limit.
An evolution not even the frost race knew of.
scene.dmzkicontrol.frostdemon.legendaryf: Metal parts where there used to be wounds.
A whole body of metal that repairs itself.
The Big Gete Star core takes command.
scene.dmzkicontrol.majin.pureforms.kid.s: The original Majin: small, pure chaos with no brakes.
The evil that left Fat Buu takes a body of its own.
scene.dmzkicontrol.majin.pureforms.super: The fusion of the two Buus: tall, cold, and hungry.
scene.dmzkicontrol.majin.pureforms.ultra: Absorbed warriors give the Majin their strength.
A huge, shapeless body, swollen with foul energy.
The final form of pure evil: fast, red, and armed with a sword.
scene.dmzkicontrol.bioandroid.bioevoluti: One android absorbed. The tail closes back up.
Both androids complete. Perfection, at last.
Coming back from the explosion made the cells even stronger.

scene.dmzkicontrol.alien.alienforms.asce: Climbing one step in the species' evolution.
scene.dmzkicontrol.alien.alienforms.cosm: A power that seems to come from the stars themselves.
